reasons: The 21.1 replacement installs the exact preferred greater-of cap: limb (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim, limb (b) USD 1,000,000, while retaining the untouched mutuality sentence.

Replacing the narrow "Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form" basis with lowercase "fees" cures the illusory USD 12,000 cap created by the definitions in 1.5-1.6 without disturbing those definitions for pricing purposes.

The 21.3 edit is the minimum needed to deliver the preferred element that Customer's payment obligations generally (not merely undisputed Fees) are not damages; the prior undisputed-Fees language is preserved as an inclusion.

Damages exclusion (21.2), the direct-damages examples, and the full Excluded Claims list are untouched and remain fully effective; no undefined term, contradiction, or dangling mechanic is introduced.
No extra words, no fallback-only requirement imported, and no whole-clause rewrite beyond the operative cap sentence.
